title: On isotrivial cone structures of highest weight type
summary: We study the projective-geometric criterion of Hwang-Li for isotrivial cone structures admitting characteristic conic connections. We give a complete classification of flag varieties satisfying this criterion, and in the process characterize flag varieties with an injective Gaussian map. As an application, we classify germs of minimal rational curves whose VMRT at a general point is isomorphic to that of a non-homogeneous smooth projective symmetric variety of Picard number one, apart from two exceptional cases.
